findings.issue: `variable [Finite G]` is newly introduced to cover `indVirtualCharactersOfSubgroupAddHom` (line 119) and `indVirtualCharactersOfSubgroupAddHom_apply_coe` (line 128), but nothing in either needs it: the map is built from `indClassFunAddHom S` and `indClassFun_mem_virtualCharacters S`, both of which take `[S.FiniteIndex]` (lines 97 and ClassFunction.lean:172). Every other declaration in this file — including `indClassFun_mem_virtualCharacters`, the exact statement this def bundles — is stated at `[S.FiniteIndex]`, so the bundled form is strictly less general than the unbundled one.

summary: The prior generality findings are resolved: the rationalized induction map is now general in the subgroup family and the weaker determinant-multiplier development is deleted. One new issue: the bundled per-subgroup induction map assumes `[Finite G]` where the lemma it bundles, three lines above it in the same file, needs only `[S.FiniteIndex]`.
